# Marilla Cuthbert & Rachel Lynde

- [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) — Friend of — [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) — neighborly acquaintance who seeks her advice · since v1  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER I. Mrs. Rachel Lynde Is Surprised P12](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0012), [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P83](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0083), [v1 CHAPTER XXX. The Queen’s Class Is Organized P40](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0040)</sub>

## Shared scenes

> Mrs. Rachel [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) notices [Matthew Cuthbert](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) unexpectedly dressed up and driving out of [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea). Curious about his unusual errand, she visits [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) and learns that [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) has gone to [Bright River](../codex/places.md#bright-river) to pick up an orphan boy they are adopting from [Nova Scotia](../codex/places.md#nova-scotia). Surprised and skeptical, Mrs. Rachel voices her deep misgivings before leaving to spread the astonishing news.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER I. Mrs. Rachel Lynde Is Surprised

> Mrs. Rachel [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) visits [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) and severely insults Anne's looks, prompting [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to fly into a furious rage and yell at her. After Mrs. Rachel leaves in an huff, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) confronts [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) in her bedroom and demands she apologize to Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), but [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) adamantly refuses.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER IX. Mrs. Rachel Lynde Is Properly Horrified

> [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) secretly visits [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) in her room and gently persuades her to apologize to Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) so she can leave her punishment. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) dramatically apologizes to Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), turning her penance into an enjoyable performance and earning Mrs. Lynde's forgiveness. As they walk back to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) feels a surge of maternal affection for [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md).
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER X. Anne’s Apology

> [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) shows [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) her new clothes, which [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) finds disappointingly plain without puffed sleeves. The following morning, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) stays home sick while [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) decorates her hat with flowers and attends Sunday school alone. Upon returning, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) recounts her experiences at church and her impression of the service and her teacher, Miss [Rogerson](../character/rogerson.md).
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XI. Anne’s Impressions of Sunday-school

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) comes inside after being called by [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and excitedly asks if she can go to the upcoming Sunday-school picnic. [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) agrees to let her go and promises to bake a basket of food for her, which prompts an affectionate hug from [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md). While doing her patchwork, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) talks enthusiastically about her and Diana's playhouse, [Idlewild](../codex/places.md#idlewild), and her intense anticipation for the picnic.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XIII. The Delights of Anticipation

> After Mr. [Phillips](../character/phillips.md) humiliates [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) by forcing her to sit next to [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), she rejects Gilbert's attempts to apologize and swears never to return to school. [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) consults Mrs. Rachel [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), who advises her to humor [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) until she cools down. Meanwhile, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) maintains her fierce grudge against Gilbert while weeping melodramatically over the thought of [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) eventually marrying and leaving her.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot

> [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) gives [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) permission to invite [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) over for tea while she is away in [Carmody](../codex/places.md#carmody). [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) entertains [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), serving her three glasses of what she believes to be raspberry cordial, but [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) becomes severely dizzy and sick and has to leave. On Monday, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) learns from Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) that Mrs. [Barry](../character/josephine-barry.md) accuses her of getting [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) drunk, leading [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) to discover that [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) mistakenly served three-year-old currant wine.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XVI. Diana Is Invited to Tea with Tragic Results

> While [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and Mrs. Rachel attend a political rally in [Charlottetown](../codex/places.md#charlottetown), [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) spend a quiet evening at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables). [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md) rushes in desperately seeking help because her little sister, [Minnie May](../character/minnie-may.md), is dangerously ill with croup and their parents are away. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) uses her past experience with twins to treat [Minnie May](../character/minnie-may.md), saving her life, which leads Mrs. [Barry](../character/josephine-barry.md) to forgive [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and allow her and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) to be best friends once again.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XVIII. Anne to the Rescue

> After signaling [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) with candles, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) persuades [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md)—with Matthew's quiet assistance—to let her stay overnight at Diana's and attend the [Debating Club](../codex/factions.md#debating-club) concert. At the concert, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) enjoys the performances but ignores [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md). When [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) return home and leap into the spare-room bed, they inadvertently jump on Diana's elderly [Aunt Josephine](../character/josephine-barry.md), causing a uproar that [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) later discusses with Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md).
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XIX. A Concert, a Catastrophe, and a Confession

> After discussing the bed-jumping incident with Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) goes to [Orchard Slope](../codex/places.md#orchard-slope) to apologize directly to [Aunt Josephine](../character/josephine-barry.md). Anne's dramatic honesty and charm win over Miss [Barry](../character/josephine-barry.md), who decides to stay in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) and continue paying for Diana's music lessons.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XIX. A Concert, a Catastrophe, and a Confession

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) returns home emotional on the last day of school as Mr. [Phillips](../character/phillips.md) makes his farewell speech to the students. Soon after, the community welcomes a new minister, Mr. [Allan](../character/allan.md), and his young wife, who quickly become beloved in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea). [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) make elaborate preparations at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) to host the Allans for tea, but when Anne's proudly baked layer cake is finally served, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) tastes something terribly wrong with it.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XXI. A New Departure in Flavorings

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) returns home thrilled to receive an invitation to tea at the manse from Mrs. Allan. Despite her fears of rain and improper etiquette, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) enjoys a wonderful afternoon at the manse with Mrs. Allan and another girl, [Lauretta](../character/lauretta.md). She returns to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) in high spirits, recounting her evening to [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and sharing news of the new female schoolteacher, Miss Muriel [Stacy](../character/stacy.md).
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XXII. Anne Is Invited Out to Tea

> During a game of dares at Diana's party, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) attempts to walk the ridgepole of the Barrys' kitchen roof and falls, breaking her ankle. Mr. [Barry](../character/josephine-barry.md) carries [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) home to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), where [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) realizes how deeply she cares for her and [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) summons the doctor. During her seven weeks of bed rest, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) is comforted by visits from her schoolmates, friends, and neighbors.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XXIII. Anne Comes to Grief in an Affair of Honor

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) returns to school in October and blossoms under the encouraging guidance of her new teacher, Miss [Stacy](../character/stacy.md). She enthusiastically discusses her school activities and composition writing with [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md). When Miss [Stacy](../character/stacy.md) organizes a Christmas concert to raise money for a school flag, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) eagerly prepares her recitations and roles despite Marilla's skepticism and Matthew's quiet support.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XXIV. Miss Stacy and Her Pupils Get Up a Concert

> [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) notices that [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) dresses differently from other girls and resolves to buy her a pretty dress with puffed sleeves for Christmas. After a hilarious and embarrassing attempt to buy dress goods at the store in [Carmody](../codex/places.md#carmody), [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) seeks the assistance of Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), who agrees to buy the material and sew the dress in secret. On Christmas morning, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) is overwhelmed with joy to receive the fashionable dress from [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md), as well as a pair of slippers sent by [Aunt Josephine](../character/josephine-barry.md), which she proudly wears at the successful school concert that evening.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XXV. Matthew Insists on Puffed Sleeves

> [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) brings [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) a Christmas gift of elegant slippers from [Aunt Josephine](../character/josephine-barry.md). Later, after the successful [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) concert where [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) stars in her recitations, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) walk home discussing the evening's triumphs and gossip. Afterwards, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) sit by the kitchen fire and express pride in [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), beginning to contemplate her future education.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XXV. Matthew Insists on Puffed Sleeves

> As life in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) settles back into a routine after the concert, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) turns thirteen and walks along [Birch Path](../codex/places.md#birch-path) with [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md), discussing her birthday, a fictional story she wrote, and the idea of forming a story club. Later, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) explains the newly formed story club to [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), who scoffs at the endeavor as a foolish waste of time while reminding [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to focus on her chores.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XXVI. The Story Club Is Formed

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) reflects on her silent rivalry and unresolved feelings toward Gilbert as the school term comes to a close. Miss [Stacy](../character/stacy.md) reassures the class that she will return next year to guide them through the Queen's entrance preparation. After school ends, Mrs. Rachel [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) visits [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), discussing Matthew's health with [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and praising Anne's growth and maturity over the years.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XXX. The Queen’s Class Is Organized

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) completes her term at [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) school and travels to [Charlottetown](../codex/places.md#charlottetown) for the [Entrance](../codex/places.md#entrance) examinations, writing to [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) about her nerve-wracking experience. After three agonizing weeks of waiting back home at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) brings the published pass list showing [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) tied for first place on the Island. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) shares the joyful news with [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md), [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), and Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), and ends her night with a thankful prayer for her future.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XXXII. The Pass List Is Out

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) learns she won the Avery scholarship while [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) wins the medal, bringing pride to [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md), [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), and [Aunt Josephine](../character/josephine-barry.md) during Commencement. Returning home to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) for the summer, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) catches up with [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md), learns of Gilbert's plans to teach, and notices the deteriorating health of both [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) and [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) as well as rumors about their bank. After a restful day revisiting her favorite spots, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) shares a touching conversation with [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md), who tells her how proud he is of her before a turning point in her life.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XXXVI. The Glory and the Dream

> [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) dies suddenly from shock after reading a newspaper account of the bank failure, devastating [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md). Friends and neighbors gather to support them through the funeral, and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) opens up about her deep grief to [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and Mrs. Allan. Later, while sitting together at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) reveals to [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) a past romance and quarrel she had with Gilbert Blythe's father.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XXXVII. The Reaper Whose Name Is Death

> [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) returns from the oculist with news that her failing vision requires her to quit reading and sewing, forcing her to consider selling [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables). [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) decides to give up her college scholarship to stay at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) and teach, comforting [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md). After Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) reveals that [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) gave up the [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) teaching position for her, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) meets Gilbert on the road, where they finally make peace and become close friends.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XXXVIII. The Bend in the Road
